title: Chief Justice Warns Against Dragging Supreme Court Into Political Battles
detail: Chief Justice of India publicly warned political actors not to drag the Supreme Court into partisan battles or bring politics to court — a statement widely read as a response to the ongoing youth protest movement's litigation and the government's use of courts to detain demonstrators.

media.caption: Chief Justice of India warns against politicising the Supreme Court

title: CJP Leaders Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka Detained at Anti-CEC Delhi Protest
detail: CJP (Citizens for Justice and Peace) leaders Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka were detained by police at the anti-CEC Delhi protest against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Police separately requested an extension of CAPF (Central Armed Police Forces) deployment, signalling expectations of continued unrest as demonstrators press for Kumar's resignation over electoral-roll revision controversies.

media.caption: CJP leaders detained at anti-CEC protest in Delhi

title: India Youth Protesters Shift Tactics as Police Clamp Down on Election Demonstrations
detail: Indian youth protesters are adapting their methods in response to intensifying police crackdowns on election-related demonstrations. The movement, originally sparked by the NEET-UG paper leak and CBSE marking irregularities, has evolved to focus on demands for the Chief Election Commissioner's resignation, with organisers now employing decentralised tactics to evade police interdiction.

media.caption: India youth protesters adapt tactics amid police crackdowns on election protests
